name: Witch Hunter: Flames of Sin's Fire hit is an uncritical 40% copy that Flourish cleaves to 3 more enemies
contract: Flames of Sin 803422 reads 'Your auto attacks now deal an additional ${$w1}% of the damage dealt as Fire
Damage.' (40%); its hit 802850 carries SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS, so it is the swing's own
resolved amount, not a new hit that rolls a crit (a crit would deal 60% or more). Flourish 805365 reads
'...causing your Flames of Sin to cleave up to $s3 additional enemies' and grants Flames of Sin for
$/1000;s2 = 10 s; its effect 2 is SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS +3 (BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1) on 802850 (family 21,
flags word 2 0x4000). 802850 has EffectChainTarget 0, so the stock chain holds 0 + 3 = 3 targets, the primary
and two more. ApplyAscensionWitchHunterFlameContracts sets ChainTarget 1 (1 + 3 = the primary and three more)
and SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, and spell_ascension_witch_hunter_flame_damage requires that attribute. The contract
was guarded on EffectBonusMultiplier 0.25, but ascension_stock_coefficients registers first and clears that
field for 802850 in the same OnLoadSpellCustomAttr pass, so the contract never applied, the damage script
failed Validate ('did not pass Validate() ... spell_ascension_witch_hunter_flame_damage'), and 802850 used the
native path: it could crit and it chained to two extra enemies. With 10000 spell crit rating every Fire hit
that can crit does. Four Harvest Golems stand 2 yards apart in a line from the primary target, inside the
10 yard magic jump radius, so the chain reaches the farthest only with four targets. The Fire total on the
primary target must be 40% of the auto attack damage under the buff (floored per hit). Ratings remove melee
misses, dodges and parries and the Fire hit's spell miss.
